newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares fall with major European bourses.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares fall with major European bourses.

text.p: Norwegian shares fell with other European bourses in moderate trade on Monday amid a weak opening on Wall Street.
Losses were registered in all four indexes -- shipping, industry, insurance and banking.
Oslo's Total share index dropped 0.49 percent to 1,099.83 points in trade worth 718 million crowns for the third lowest turnover in a session this year.
"People are uncertain about interest rates," one dealer said. "That's why things are so quiet today."
Most traded share at just 36 million crowns was Norsk Hydro, which fell 4.50 crowns to 342 crowns.
Aker Maritime gained two crowns to finish at 109 crowns after winning a 250 million crown contract linked to the North Sea Jotun oil development.

Kvaerner announced it had signed a letter of intent for the construction of a production ship for Jotun. The deal was worth about two billion crowns, but the news had been anticipated and the A share ended unchanged at 364 crowns.
